verdict.rationale: Discord documents its own test modes, but only for monetization. Test entitlements simulate subscribed and unsubscribed states, and Application Test Mode allows one-time purchases without credit card charges. The same source states that no sandbox environment exists for the API as a whole, so bots, interactions, messages and Gateway events can only be tested against the live platform. missing for 10: a general sandbox or non-production environment for the Discord API beyond billing, isolated test data for bots and interactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can test your implementation by creating and deleting test entitlements. These entitlements will allow you to test your premium offering in both a subscribed and unsubscribed state
